name: Meadow Breeze Day Camp
description_short: Weekly day camp on the Lexington Christian Academy campus for children entering kindergarten through grade 8. Days run 8 to 3 and include a swim class and free swim, plus archery, tennis, drama, music, crafts, sports and the climbing wall.
refund_policy_summary: A $35 registration fee and a $200 deposit per session apply. Cancel by February 1 for a full refund less the registration fee; cancel February 2 to April 1 for a refund less the registration fee and deposit. After April 1 there are no refunds, but a session can be transferred.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily extended swim period with a skill based swim class and free swim. Each camper gets a swim assessment based on American Red Cross standards on arrival.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Day Camp for campers entering K through grade 8, Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. AfterCamp 3:30 to 5:30 PM costs extra ($100 or $150 a week). Lunch is an optional paid add-on ($45 a week if added by April 1, $50 after); families may pack a nut free lunch. Registration for 2027 opens December 7, 2026 (returning) and December 8 (new).

Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027: eight one week sessions June 28 to August 20, $630 a week, $504 for the four day week of July 5 (no camp Monday July 5). Day Camp families save $50 per camper per week if they register by December 14, 2026. A $35 registration fee and $200 deposit per session apply. Registration not yet open, so availability is unknown.

warnings: Ages are not stated; the camp gives grades only (entering K through 8).
Operated by Lexington Christian Academy, a Christian school. The camp pages do not describe any religious program, so religious_affiliation is left empty.
Price is before the $50 per week early registration discount and excludes the $35 registration fee.
